resources.name: restrictions
resources.description: Local and state laws that constrain renewable deployment, one row per technology of one instrument.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable record id; never renumbered between builds.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Two-letter state code.

fields.name: technology
fields.description: solar, wind, battery_storage, transmission, hydro or geothermal; one per row (restrictions, siting standards) or a semicolon list (projects, policies).

fields.name: restriction_type
fields.description: The mechanism that drives the score (driving_type): ban, moratorium, ban_or_moratorium, setback, height_limit, noise_limit, size_cap, zoning_restriction, siting_standard, other.

fields.name: severity_score
fields.description: 1 mild friction, 2 material burden, 3 likely de facto ban, 4 moratorium or ban (restrictions); 4 blocked to 1 advanced (contested projects).

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the source says the record is, in one or two sentences, as the source wrote it.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Restrictions: active, extended, pending or unknown. Projects: the source's status label, which the outcome ladder maps (build_sabin_seeds.OUTCOME).

fields.name: jurisdiction
fields.description: The government that adopted the instrument, as the source names it.

fields.name: jurisdiction_type
fields.description: County, Parish, Borough, Town, City, Township, State and the like, as the source gives it.

fields.name: date_enacted_iso
fields.description: Adoption date, YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, when the source gives one.

fields.name: date_text
fields.description: The source's own wording of the date(s), kept when it does not reduce to one ISO date.

fields.name: mechanisms
fields.description: Every mechanism the instrument uses, comma-separated, in the MECHANISM_TYPE vocabulary.

fields.name: severity_basis
fields.description: The rule that set severity_score.

fields.name: long_description
fields.description: The source's fuller account, or a queue row's mechanism values.

fields.name: moratorium_id
fields.description: Moratorium Nation's identifier for the instrument.

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: The Sabin Center record the row comes from (REC- for the 2025 edition, S26R-/S26P- for 2026); a case's source_record_id names the project or restriction it concerns.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The dataset or document the row was built from, as a label.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The source document's address. Required on every row.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Provenance notes: how the row was promoted or corrected.

fields.name: sabin_edition
fields.description: Which Sabin edition the row comes from: 2026-09 or 2025-06.

fields.name: edition_status
fields.description: How the 2025 row fared in the 2026 edition: carried, missing or ambiguous (data/review/sabin_edition_crosswalk.csv).

fields.name: pinned_id
fields.description: The published id a promoted or rebuilt row keeps, so a correction never renumbers it.

fields.name: source_county_fips
fields.description: A county code the source itself gives (NREL), used only when nothing else places the row.

fields.name: current_end_date_iso
fields.description: The date a moratorium runs to, as the source gives it; the currency rule reads it.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Coordinates the source gives, checked against the state's bounding box.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Coordinates the source gives, checked against the state's bounding box.

fields.name: needs_verification
fields.description: Moratorium Nation's [VERIFY] flag: yes when the source itself asks for a check.

fields.name: sectors
fields.description: Moratorium Nation's sectors list; data_center in it makes the scope multi_sector_data_centers.

fields.name: legal_basis
fields.description: The ordinance, resolution or statute the source cites.

fields.name: primary_source_verdict
fields.description: confirmed or contradicts: what the reviewer found when reading the primary source.

fields.name: queue_id
fields.description: The review-queue row a promoted record came from.

fields.name: source_kind
fields.description: What source_url is: instrument, minutes, official_copy, court_record, news, tracker or other.

fields.name: primary_source_access
fields.description: How the primary source was seen: opened, archived or snippet.

fields.name: primary_source_url
fields.description: The instrument or its minutes, from a reviewer's restriction_sources.csv row.

fields.name: nrel_id
fields.description: NREL's identifier for the ordinance (technology and FIPS code).

fields.name: ordinance_url
fields.description: The ordinance text NREL links to.

fields.name: nrel_jurisdiction_type
fields.description: NREL's own jurisdiction type for the ordinance.

fields.name: conflicts_with
fields.description: Another source's instrument for the same jurisdiction and technology whose values disagree.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Hash of the normalized source URL; joins sources.csv.

fields.name: instrument_id
fields.description: One ordinance, moratorium, project or case. Count these, not rows.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: renewables_only, or multi_sector_data_centers when the instrument also covers data centers.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: in_force, lapsed_unconfirmed (the instrument's own end date has passed with no confirmed extension), pending or unknown (no status); derived from the source's dates, not its status word.

fields.name: status_as_of
fields.description: The latest date the status is known to have held: an 'as of' date in the text, the enactment date or a reviewer's check.

fields.name: evidence_level
fields.description: Best evidence behind the row: primary_source, confirmed, court_record, compiled_record, compiled_flagged, report_citation.

fields.name: verification
fields.description: verified (the instrument, minutes, a read news article or a court record backs it), located (primary source found, not yet read) or unverified.

fields.name: county_fips
fields.description: The one county a county-level record covers; the county the map paints.

fields.name: county_fips_all
fields.description: Every county the record touches, semicolon-separated.

fields.name: county_fips_method
fields.description: How county_fips_all was found: name, names, point, place, place_text, override.

fields.name: state_siting_authority
fields.description: who_decides of the state's siting_authority row for the technology.

fields.name: state_threshold_mw
fields.description: The MW size above which the state body decides, from that row's threshold_mw.

fields.name: state_preemption_ids
fields.description: state_policies ids of local_preemption rows covering the technology.

fields.name: state_limits_local
fields.description: yes when the state's verified siting law (state_policies) limits how far a local instrument reaches for the row's technology (a size threshold, a preemption rule, or a state board that decides outright), no when local government decides with no such rule, unknown when no verified policy covers the technology. Context only; never says an instrument is void.

fields.name: primary_source_checked_on
fields.description: The date the reviewer checked the primary source.

fields.name: primary_source_archived_url
fields.description: The Internet Archive copy the reviewer read, when access is archived.

fields.name: placement_url
fields.description: The document a reviewer's place override rests on (data/review/place_overrides.csv).

fields.name: placement_access
fields.description: How that document was seen: opened, archived or snippet.

fields.name: status_checked_on
fields.description: The date two reviewers settled the instrument's status from its code, the instrument or the minutes that acted on it (data/review/status_resolutions.csv); blank when no status reading has been made.

fields.name: status_evidence_url
fields.description: The document the status reading rests on; blank when no status reading has been made.

fields.name: resolution_url

fields.name: resolution_access

fields.name: facility_ids
fields.description: The matched plant's rows in data/reference/facilities.csv.

fields.name: facility_name
fields.description: The matched plant's name in the federal inventory.

fields.name: facility_status
fields.description: What the inventory records for the plant: operating, under_construction, planned, canceled_or_postponed or retired.

fields.name: facility_capacity_mw

fields.name: facility_year

fields.name: facility_longitude
fields.description: The matched plant's coordinates in the inventory.

fields.name: facility_note

fields.name: facility_conflict
fields.description: Set when the plant's status contradicts the published outcome.
